item.title: OpenStack Cloud Server Provisioning
item.description: From the web dashboard to the CLI, a complete walkthrough of provisioning OpenStack cloud servers: creating and deleting tenants/users/images/flavors/networks/routers/security groups/key pairs/floating IPs, plus iptables SNAT/DNAT and Nova cell_v2 discover_hosts troubleshooting.
